scope: Nested GNOME Wayland portal interface and Screenshot request probe

commands.command: Xvfb :99; dbus-run-session; gnome-shell --nested --wayland --no-x11; pipewire; wireplumber; xdg-desktop-portal; xdg-desktop-portal-gnome
commands.assertions: GNOME Shell created the nested Wayland socket and AT-SPI registry. PipeWire started, but org.gnome.Shell.Screencast failed to open the nested display.

The portal object advertised Screenshot, ScreenCast, and RemoteDesktop interfaces and returned a Request object, but the backend failed with No such interface org.freedesktop.impl.portal.Screenshot before any response or capture.

limitations: Nested GNOME cannot initialize its screencast service in this headless Xvfb setup; an actual GNOME user-session compositor remains required.
This probe does not prove NAT-06 or the GNOME support row.
